about_the_game:
Miners in the Mountain is a pixel-art card-based RPG inspired by Escape from Tarkov.
Before the collapse comes, fight enemies with cards, scavenge supplies, and build a base in the mineshaft as you delve deeper underground.

But beware—failure means losing everything: food, spare parts, crew members… all gone. Along the way, you'll meet allies and enemies, slowly assembling an exploration team deck. Never forget your ultimate goal—the “Heart of the Mountain.”

Who am I? Where am I?

You were found unconscious in the mines. Yue’er, a ventilation technician, saved you. No one in the Mining Bureau recognizes you, and you remember nothing—not your name, not your past… only a promise to find the Heart of the Mountain.

But… who did you make that promise to?

  • Where should I go?

  • "Didn’t you say you were searching for the Heart of the Mountain?"

Build Your Team, Advance Carefully

The mines are filled with deadly creatures, hostile miners, and crumbling tunnels. Strengthen your camp with supply cards and team reinforcements, then push onward.

  • "Where is the Heart of the Mountain?"

  • "Down. Deeper."

One Misstep, Lose Everything

Every descent could be your last battle. Defeat means losing all—food, gear, even your squad. Store backup supplies in your base camp… or gamble everything.
—What happens if I fail?
—“Death. Even if you escape alive, your supplies and comrades won’t.”

Dig Deeper, Uncover the Truth

As you venture further, you’ll encounter strange tales and cryptic events. At the journey’s end lies the secret you seek—the truth behind the Heart of the Mountain…
—Who are you?
—“The Mountain God.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R7 260x
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Directx-compatible sound card

short_description: “Miners in the Mountain” is a pixel card RPG with Tarkov-like survival. Fight, loot, and build bases in collapsing mines. Failure will cost you everything—food, components, crew members, all vanishes. Meet allies and foes, build your expedition squad deck, dig deeper, and find the Mountain's Heart.
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Vietnamese, Korean, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America
